method: The corpus hash/blob are fail-closed before scanning.

For each passage, title, passage text, all question prompts, all keyed answers, and nonempty answer explanations are concatenated with blank-line separators for one local LanguageTool request per passage.
Match offsets are mapped back to the exact learner-facing field/item. Raw detector findings are preserved without automatic correction.
LanguageTool is treated as an independent error detector, not an authority. Every finding requires contextual adjudication before any repair.
